name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width-to-height ratio to constrain the content to, e.g. `16 / 9`. Defaults to `1`.

examples.title: Default
examples.source: import AspectRatio from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.marko";
examples.description: A `16 / 9` ratio, the common case for images and video.

examples.title: Square
examples.source:
import AspectRatio from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.marko";
1:1
examples.description: A `1 / 1` ratio, useful for displaying images in a square format.

examples.title: Portrait
examples.source: import AspectRatio from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.marko";
examples.description: A `9 / 16` ratio, useful for displaying images in a portrait format.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source: import AspectRatio from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.marko";
examples.description: To enable RTL support, set `dir="rtl"` on an ancestor. AspectRatio itself has no physical (left/right) styling to flip.

examples.title: Content card
examples.source:
import AspectRatio from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.marko";
4:3 content Video thumbnail placeholder
examples.description: Ratios apply to any content, not just images — here a `4 / 3` placeholder card.

examples.title: Ultrawide banner

examples.description: A `21 / 9` ratio for wide banner layouts.
